channel.title: Blockchain Today
channel.description: Blockchain Today reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and network upgrades, with analysis of what changed.

item.title: Budgeting Treasury Transfers Across Chains
item.description: Cross-chain treasury budgets should start with the amount needed on the destination chain, then account for route fees, conversion, gas and liquidity limits.

item.title: Moving Crypto Without Losing Staking Eligibility
item.description: Moving crypto does not automatically move its stake: check whether rewards follow a validator, delegated balance, or provider token, then plan any exit delay.

item.title: Bridge limits can change the cost of a large crypto swap
item.description: A bridge cap can turn one quoted cross-chain swap into several transfers, changing fees, timing and execution risk; compare the route before splitting.

item.title: Why Your BTC-to-ETH Swap Is Waiting on Bitcoin
item.description: A BTC-to-ETH swap cannot move until its Bitcoin deposit is confirmed; checking the transaction status helps distinguish a slow BTC transfer from a later swap delay.

item.title: Why Split Swaps Can Beat a Direct Route
item.description: A direct swap saves execution steps, while split routes can improve output by combining liquidity; compare fees, gas and minimum received before signing.

item.title: Bridge First or Swap First? The Route Changes the Cost
item.description: Bridge first or swap first depends on where the needed token has deeper liquidity, what the route costs, and whether you need one or two transactions.

item.title: A Cross-Chain Refund Depends on Where a Transfer Stalls
item.description: A cross-chain refund returns recoverable funds after a route stalls, but the chain, token, timing and user action depend on where execution stopped.

item.title: Ledger finds LTE implants in CryptoBilis-sold wallets
item.description: Ledger says implants in CryptoBilis-sold wallets copied setup phrases over LTE, exposing a supply-chain gap as the company tightens reseller controls.

item.title: Why Crypto Treasury Transfers Run on Two Settlement Clocks
item.description: A crypto treasury transfer runs on a network clock and an operating clock; separating them shows when assets are final, usable and ready to reconcile internally.

item.title: Keep Gas Ready Before You Use a New Crypto Chain
item.description: A small balance of the destination chain’s fee token keeps swaps and transfers available; bridge costs, token rules and wallet sponsorship determine how much to hold.

item.title: Choosing a Bitcoin Cross-Chain Swap Route
item.description: The right Bitcoin swap route depends on the asset you need, the full quoted cost, settlement time and who controls funds while the swap completes.

item.title: A Pending Bridge Transfer Has More Than One Status
item.description: A bridge transfer can be confirmed on its source chain and still be waiting elsewhere. Follow the transaction, message and destination credit before retrying.

item.title: Why a cross-chain transfer can stay pending after it is sent
item.description: A cross-chain transfer can stay pending after its source transaction succeeds because the bridge still needs confirmation, verification and destination execution.

item.title: Securitize launches 12 tokenized stocks on Solana
item.description: Securitize launched 12 share-backed stock tokens on Solana, adding a regulated broker-dealer route while NYSE and OKXICE trading remain conditional.

item.title: EBA makes Circle’s USDC first significant MiCA e-money token
item.description: The EBA named Circle’s USDC the EU’s first significant e-money token, shifting key reserve and liquidity oversight from France on Nov. 12.

item.title: Acrossbridge turns a Solana USDC balance into Ethereum ETH
item.description: A one-flow swap can replace a separate bridge and Ethereum purchase, but the route still depends on network support, execution costs and the ETH delivered.

item.title: biswap bridge or swap: choose the route that matches your destination
item.description: A bridge moves assets between networks, while a swap changes the asset; compare the destination, total route and risks before choosing how to move funds.

item.title: Ripple adds Privy wallets as XRPL agent payments top 14m
item.description: Ripple and Stripe-owned Privy are adding embedded XRP Ledger wallets for apps and AI agents, as a live index passes 14 million payments but shows modest value.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes overflow flaw that could mint 18 trillion XRP
item.description: XRPL’s 3.4.1 release closed an overflow flaw that could have created spendable XRP; its emergency rollout traded the usual validator vote for faster protection.

item.title: GSR commits $100 million to launch onchain credit vaults
item.description: GSR is committing $100 million, mostly as a credit facility, to Hare’s Aave-powered dollar and gold vaults, putting onchain credit underwriting to the test.
